name: Paying Debts
overview: Scripture teaches that faithful stewardship includes the wise management of debts, warning believers against becoming sureties or borrowing unnecessarily, as this leads to servitude to the lender. God’s blessing is promised to those who work diligently and lend rather than borrow, reflecting righteousness and mercy. It is better to avoid making vows or promises that cannot be fulfilled, emphasizing integrity and responsibility in all financial commitments.
